diagnostics.title: Sync details
diagnostics.couldNotCopy: Could not copy — select the text and copy it by hand.
diagnostics.collapsedHint: Balances, pending holds and the last sync result for every account, as text you can copy.
diagnostics.help: If a balance doesn't match your bank, copy this and send it along. It contains no passwords or bank credentials.

lock.title: Money is locked
lock.setUpBody: Pick a PIN. Only people who know it can see the family's accounts — the household password isn't enough, because anyone can switch profiles without one.
lock.noAccess: You don't have access to the money section.
lock.lockedOut: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
lock.failedAttempts: {n} failed unlock attempt since you last signed in. | {n} failed unlock attempts since you last signed in.
lock.resetArmed: A PIN reset was armed on this server. Set a new PIN to claim the money section.
lock.honest: Anyone with access to this server can read this data. The PIN keeps it off the family tablet, not out of a determined attacker's hands.

setup.title: Set up Money
setup.subtitle: Private to the people you choose
setup.intro: Money keeps the family's accounts, spending, budgets and bills in one place. It sits behind its own PIN, so it never shows on the wall display or the shared calendar.
setup.adminOnly: Money hasn't been set up yet. Ask an admin to set it up — they choose the PIN and can then give you access.
setup.privacy: Anyone with access to this server can read this data. The PIN keeps it off the family tablet, not out of a determined attacker's hands.

pin.title: Choose a PIN
pin.body: Six characters or more. You'll enter it whenever you open Money.

accounts.title: Add an account
accounts.body: Connect a bank through SimpleFIN, import a statement file, or keep an account by hand.

people.title: Decide who can see it
people.body: Money is private until you give someone access, each with their own PIN.

plan.title: Set budgets and bills
plan.body: Optional. Budgets show what's left this month; bills give you a forecast worth reading.

overview.shortfall: Projected to go below zero on {date}
overview.noShortfall: No shortfall projected in the next {n} days.
overview.overspentIn: Over budget in {n} category | Over budget in {n} categories
overview.nothingDue: Nothing due in the next 30 days.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.name: Account name
accounts.openingBalanceHelp: What's in it right now. Everything you add afterwards adjusts this.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Connect a bank or add one you'll keep by hand.
accounts.balanceIsBank: This balance comes from your bank and can't be edited here.
accounts.removeConfirm: Remove “{name}”? This permanently deletes the account and its transactions, and can’t be undone.
accounts.hideConfirm: Hide “{name}”? It comes from your bank, so it can't be deleted — hiding takes it out of your accounts, totals and budgets, and it stays hidden after future syncs. Its transactions are kept.
accounts.disconnectHint: To remove every account from this bank, disconnect it in
accounts.typeHelp: Only checking, savings and cash accounts count as spendable money in your cash flow forecast. Banks don’t send a type, so it starts as a guess from the account name.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.amountHelp: Negative for money out, positive for money in.
transactions.pendingHelp: Pending transactions don't count towards budgets or the forecast yet.
transactions.syncedLocked: Amount and date come from your bank.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Name
categories.inUse: Archived instead of deleted — {n} transaction still uses it. | Archived instead of deleted — {n} transactions still use it.
categories.removeConfirm: Delete “{name}”? If a transaction still uses it, it’s archived instead so your history keeps its category.
categories.archivedInstead: Archived instead of deleted — past transactions keep their category.

rules.title: Auto-categorise
rules.empty: No rules yet. Rules file transactions automatically as they arrive.
rules.neverOverwrites: Rules never change a category you set yourself.
rules.removeConfirm: Delete the rule for “{value}”? Transactions it already filed keep their category.
rules.renameHelp: Optional — tidies a messy bank description into a name you recognise.
rules.vendorHelp: Files anything paid to “{vendor}” automatically, from now on.
rules.vendorSaved: Rule saved — {vendor} will be filed automatically.

connections.title: Bank connections
connections.empty: No banks connected. You can also import a statement file instead.
connections.setupTokenHelp: Paste the token from your SimpleFIN account. It's used once and never stored.
connections.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this bank? Its accounts and transactions will be removed from the board. Your bank is not affected.

status.needs_reauth: Your bank needs you to sign in again

connections.credentialsUnreadable: This connection can't be read on this server — the encryption key is missing or has changed. Reconnect the bank.
connections.firstSyncNote: Banks usually send about 90 days of history on the first sync.
connections.encryptionNote: Your bank credentials are stored encrypted, with the key held on this server. Anyone with access to the server itself can read them.

import.title: Import a statement
import.chooseFile: Choose an OFX, QFX, or CSV file
import.duplicatesFound: {n} of these look like duplicates. | {n} of these look like duplicates.
import.undone: Undone — removed {n} transaction. | Undone — removed {n} transactions.
import.noAutoDrop: Nothing is dropped automatically — you decide on every duplicate.

warnings.noDateOrAmount: Skipped a transaction with no date or amount.
warnings.unreadableAmount: Skipped a transaction with an unreadable amount ({amount}).
warnings.badDate: Row {row}: could not read the date.
warnings.badAmount: Row {row}: could not read the amount.
warnings.unknown: A row in that file could not be read and was skipped.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.carriedForward: Copied from last month — change anything you like.
budgets.empty: Add some categories first, then set what you want to spend.
budgets.billCount: {n} bill this month | {n} bills this month

bills.title: Bills
bills.name: What is it
bills.empty: No bills yet. Adding them makes the forecast worth reading.
bills.notOnCalendar: Bills stay in this section — they never appear on the family calendar or the wall display.
bills.removeConfirm: Delete "{name}"? This permanently removes the bill and its schedule. Transactions you've already recorded aren't affected.

goals.title: Savings goals
goals.name: What are you saving for
goals.linkAccountHelp: Progress follows that account's balance. Leave empty to record contributions by hand.
goals.empty: No goals yet. A goal makes the leftover money mean something.
goals.linkedNoManual: This goal follows an account balance, so move money into the account instead.

forecast.title: Cash flow
forecast.explain: Today's spendable balance, plus your bills and income, minus what you usually spend day to day.
forecast.basedOn: Everyday spending is averaged from the last 90 days.
forecast.notCounted: Not counted here: {accounts} ({amount}). Set the account type to Checking, Savings or Cash to include it.

members.title: Who can see money
members.roleHelp: Owners can connect banks and manage who has access. Members can see and edit everything else.
members.choosePinHelp: Tell them the PIN — they can change it themselves afterwards.
members.removeConfirm: Remove {name}'s access to the money section?
members.lastOwner: You can't remove the last owner.

settings.title: Money
settings.currencyHelp: Used for totals and new accounts. Bank accounts keep whatever currency your bank reports.
settings.notOnDashboard: Money never appears on the dashboard, the wall display, or the shared calendar.
settings.adminOnly: Only a household admin can change these.

toast.pinSet: PIN set — unlock with it now

splits.title: Split across categories
splits.subtitle: {description} · {amount}
splits.help: Give each part of this receipt its own category. The parts have to add up to the whole.
splits.splitLocked: Split across categories — open the split editor to change it.
